title: Compact generation of the quasi-coherent derived category
statement: For every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the derived category D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] is compactly generated.

proof.text: Choose derived localizations on all opens in the ambient Hom universe. Apply the triangulated-property clause of supported_perfect_generator with support T=X: the complement is empty and the support condition is vacuous, so its property is schemeDerivedQCohProperty X. Supply the existing coproducts. No target hypothesis is added.

Choose a set-indexed family of perfect representatives. Each is compact by perfectObjectCompact. Perfect generation identifies the perfect localizing closure with top; the representative detection lemma therefore proves that the family coproduct is a weak generator.
Use the chosen index type and family, pointwise compactness and generating-family proof as witnesses in the definition of compact generation.
